entries.heading: From the unobligated balances available in the Securities
ancestors: DIVISION E—FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2014
entries.text:
Sec. 628.  From the unobligated balances available in the Securities 
and Exchange Commission Reserve Fund established by section 991 of the 
Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act (Public Law 
111-203), $25,000,000 are rescinded.
